Notion was initially a workspace I loved and used extensively (for work/academics/personal) for years. However, their decision to push numerous incredibly *intrusive* AI features on top of replacing essential UI components with AI toggles, have really left me with immense frustration. Their identity has become almost entirely focused toward AI while neglecting their core pre-existing features. I often used to recommend/introduce others to Notion (including the agency I prev worked at), and even built templates for these individuals and businesses. You can’t do it!!! I have to wait for my current subscription to expire, a month away, or start a new account and. Transfer everything which loses history and maybe some associations. Not much of a business subscription if you can’t more people!!!! The other really really bad thing is app startup time. I open my phone for a morning meeting, go to notion to start AI notes and it just sits there… I’m on WiFi, and the app takes so long to load up it misses the first part of the meeting - often the MOST critical part!  These two things take the app from great to something I can’t rely on. And if I can’t rely on it, then I have to have something else that I can rely on. Really unfortunate. insights.claim: 25 reviewers on iPhone and iPad say the page scrolls or jumps away while they type, so they cannot see their own text. Some say it has lasted months.
85 reviewers describe freezes, unresponsive taps, crashes and lost content on iOS. Several say they must force-close and reopen the app to keep working.
